datasheet_status: Production Data (p1 footer); VQFN and bare-die orderables Active (p32); automotive LMH32401-Q1 exists (p33)
citation_convention: pX = PDF page index; for PDF p1-p31 the printed page number equals the PDF index. Types: TYP / MIN / MAX = Electrical Characteristics (EC) table values; CURVE = read from a 300-dpi clip of a typical-characteristic plot (uncertainty stated); DERIVED = computed here; TEXT = datasheet prose. Default EC/TC conditions (p6-p11): VDD 3.3 V, VOCM open, VOD 0 V, CPD = 1 pF (photodiode capacitance), EN = 0 V (enabled), IDC_EN = 3.3 V (ALC disabled), RL = 100 ohm differential, TA 25 C.
architecture: Single-channel integrated TIA for pulsed LIDAR/ToF: single-ended current input -> TIA stage with switched feedback 1 kOhm / 10 kOhm (GAIN pin) -> fixed-gain single-ended-to-differential ADC-driver stage -> OUT+/OUT- each through an internal 10-ohm series resistor; VOCM pin (default 1.1 V from internal divider) and VOD pin (differential output offset, default about 0.5 V) ; integrated ambient-light (DC) cancellation loop that senses the TIA output against VREF and injects an opposing DC current IDC at IN (IDC_EN pin); 100-mA input clamp (fast-recovery clamp when the photodiode sinks current, soft clamp when it sources); EN power-down puts outputs in high impedance for multiplexing. IN sits at a self-bias of 2.47 V. Optimised for the photodiode SINKING photocurrent (cathode to IN, anode to negative bias), i.e. current flowing out of IN. [p1, p3, p20-p23]

dc_or_ambient_cancellation.name: Ambient light cancellation (ALC) loop
dc_or_ambient_cancellation.control: IDC_EN low = enabled (pin-table default), high = disabled; threshold enable < 1 V TYP (0.8 V MIN), disable > 1.8 V TYP (2 V MAX) (p3, p10). All EC and typical curves except Figs 6-9, 6-15, 6-16, 6-27 to 6-30, 6-42 are with ALC disabled.
dc_or_ambient_cancellation.polarity: works only when the photodiode sinks the photocurrent (cathode to IN, anode to negative bias) (p23)

range.conditions: differential output offset shift from IDC = 10 uA < +-10 mV

range_vs_temperature.value: 10 mV droop reached at 2.18 mA (125 C), 2.82 mA (25 C), 3.34 mA (-40 C); output collapses within about 0.1 mA beyond

curve.2k: -3 dB at 52 kHz, -1 dB at 93 kHz, no peaking
curve.20k: -3 dB at 374 kHz, -1 dB at 561 kHz, +0.86 dB peak near 2 MHz

noise_impact.text: enabling the loop adds noise; shot noise of the cancellation current increases total noise, disable if ambient light is negligible (p9 fn 4, p23)

curves.cite: p13 Figs 6-15 (2 k), 6-16 (20 k); ALC state not printed on the figures but IDC up to 1 mA implies the loop is on
curves.low_frequency_hump: 2 k, 1 mA: 51 pA/rtHz at 200 kHz; 20 k, 1 mA: 23 pA/rtHz at 2 MHz; 100 uA: 26 pA/rtHz (2 k, 200 kHz), 11 pA/rtHz (20 k, 1 MHz)

noise_impact.comparison_DERIVED: added ALC noise at 1 mA (2 k) about sqrt(11.3^2 - 9.25^2) = 6.5 pA/rtHz, below the 17.9 pA/rtHz shot noise of the 1 mA photocurrent itself

output.type: fully differential OUT+/OUT-, internal 10-ohm series resistor per output; designed to drive a 100-ohm differential load / ADC directly (p1, p21, p24)

linear_output_current.conditions: 25 C, IIN 500 uA, 2 k, RL 25 ohm; 27.1 mA at -40 C, 25.1 mA at 125 C

output.short_circuit: 70 mA differential TYP; cannot withstand a continuous short between outputs (p8)

output_impedance.curve: about 20 ohm to 50 MHz, 23 at 100 MHz, 36 at 200 MHz, 63 at 300 MHz, 133 at 500 MHz (CURVE p12 Fig 6-10)

common_mode.VOCM_noise: 17.8 nV/rtHz at 10 MHz with 1 nF on VOCM

differential_offset.rule: VOD functional only with PD sinking current; set VOD = 0 V for a sourcing PD (p22)

output.50_ohm_drive: specified into 100 ohm differential (equivalent to 50 ohm per side); linear output current 24 mA MIN into 25 ohm

overload_recovery_and_clamp.clamp: 100-mA protection clamp diverting excess input current to VDD1; fast-recovery clamp when PD sinks current, soft clamp (slower, overload-dependent recovery) when PD sources current (p20, p21)

application_guidance: Use PD sinking configuration (cathode to IN, anode to negative bias) for ALC, VOD and fast-recovery clamp; for a sourcing PD the cathode bias must exceed 2.47 V and VOD = 0 V (p22, p25-p26)
Direct drive of a 100-ohm differential ADC (ADC12QJ1600); Eq 2-4 for other loads and VOD setting (p24-p25)

Remove ground/power planes between IN and the photodiode; optional series isolation resistor at IN against bond-wire resonance; optional capacitors on VOCM and VOD; 100 pF-0.1 uF C0G plus 2.2-6.8 uF bypass on VDD1 and VDD2 separately (p28-p29)
Multiplexing via EN: up to four outputs in parallel (p23)
other_notes: EC integrated noise (250 nA at 500 MHz, 49 nA at 250 MHz) is about 25 % above the integral of the published density curves (DERIVED 202 nA, 39 nA).
ALC high-pass stated as 100 kHz (p23) but Fig 6-9 shows 52 kHz (2 k) and 374 kHz (20 k).
Eq 1 (p22) is printed with 'RL x 20 ohm' in the denominator; Eq 2 uses '+ 20 ohm' (typo).
Input bias voltage drift 1.1 mV/C (EC) vs about 0.73 mV/C in Fig 6-36.
Fig 6-18 output-noise axis unit pA/rtHz is presumably nV/rtHz.
Thermal table header says 12 pins for the 16-pin RGT package.
EC DC input range (705 uA, '3-dB degradation') is lower than the -3 dB point in Fig 6-31 (about 1 mA); the EC criterion may effectively be tighter.
